pack.name: Raw Industrialism
pack.description: Bold, high-contrast fashion editorial aesthetic featuring brutalist concrete, chrome silver, and moody urban neon vibes. Inspired by Balenciaga's raw industrial photography style.

templates.title: Industrial - Chrome Puffer
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo in a raw industrial setting. A stylish Black model in an oversized chrome-silver puffer jacket posing against a brutalist grey concrete wall with harsh, dramatic side-shadows. Sharp professional lighting, metallic textures. 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Industrial - Neon Trench
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo. A handsome Black man in a structured black leather trench coat standing on a wet asphalt street at night, reflected neon lights in the puddles. Moody atmospheric lighting, industrial city vibe. 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Industrial - Warehouse Green
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo. A Black woman in a vibrant neon-green sculptural dress posing inside a rusted steel warehouse. High-contrast lighting, raw industrial textures, sharp focus on fabric and metal. 4:5 aspect ratio.

templates.title: Industrial - Brutalist Hardware
templates.prompt_text: A photorealistic high-fashion editorial photo. Close-up of high-end designer sneakers with chrome hardware resting on a stack of industrial steel beams. Brutalist aesthetic, sharp details, grey and metallic palette. 4:5 aspect ratio.
